work.name: Polarising
work.summary: Consolidated multiple tenant-specific repositories into a single monorepo via a smart pipeline that autonomously handles tenant selection and configuration.
highlights: Leading the consolidation of multiple tenant-specific repositories into a monorepo, delivering a CI/CD pipeline that automates deployments across configurable sets of Business Units

Designing and implementing a multi-stage pipeline that includes AWS authentication, code quality and security scanning (application, repository, and Helm charts), parallel builds with library caching, Docker image and Helm chart packaging and publishing, cluster deployment, and post-deployment performance testing
Providing AWS support for a variety of operational difficulties, including as deployment failures, misconfigurations, log analysis, and environment variable management.

work.name: Polarising
work.summary: Creating a CI/CD pipeline in Gitlab to be used by over 60 maven projects
highlights: Developed and maintained a centralized GitLab CI/CD pipeline that supports 60+ Maven-based projects, including main, release, hotfix, bugfix, and feature branches. We introduced a configurable YAML templating framework to streamline shared logic across branches, reducing duplication, and making updates easier and safer. SonarQube and automated testing have been integrated directly into the development workflow to ensure code quality and security. Created a sophisticated orchestration file that modifies pipeline behavior based on the current branch and user-defined inputs, while also providing controls through variables for skipping maven tests, skipping maven javadoc creation, and setting Maven flags
Managed Kubernetes manifests and set up automated, GitOps-style deployments across all 60+ projects with ArgoCD

work.name: OpenCascade, part of Capgemini
work.summary: Revamping a legacy app’s infrastructure from Airflow to a proprietary system with Zookeeper and Kafka
highlights: Responsible for the migration of the infrastructure of a legacy application (written in Python, Java, Kotlin, C++, and Go) to a proprietary solution using Zookeeper and Kafka, reducing resource consumption by 10%. The responsibilities include: designing the new logic flow that includes the proprietary solution, creating Docker containers, Kubernetes Charts, configuring ArgoCD, and developing Gitlab pipelines.
Developing a solution that installed all required tools on developers, through Ansible
